paragraphs.text: The Guildlords of Shandalar , Alsadim K'mer , Starcryst , Lichlord Skavius Slan , Kzzy'n , and Morgane the Great Druid , were leaders of their respective guilds of Shandalar , each guild ruling over the magic of one color.

The guildlords were originally of pure intent to defend Shandalar, but were corrupted by the evil Planeswalker Arzakon 's influence in the guise of a benevolent advisor. Together, they betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar to open the path for Arzakon. The Guildlords themselves were in turn defeated, and Arzakon was banned from entering the plane.
